siblingTrailheads.trailheadDirection: From Newhalem, drive SR-20 east about 14 miles; the trailhead parking is on the right between mileposts 134 and 135.

siblingApproaches.approach: The trip starts at the Ross Dam Trailhead on SR 20 (North Cascades Highway, ~2,050ft), where parking is right off the highway. siblingTrailheads.trailhead: Downey Creek Trailhead (Trail #768, Suiattle River Road)
siblingTrailheads.trailheadDirection: From Darrington, drive Highway 530 to the Suiattle River Road (Forest Road 26) and turn east; the trailhead is in a parking lot just past the Downey Creek bridge, about 20 miles from Highway 530. Since February 2026 the road has been closed to vehicles at milepost 4 (order in place to January 2028), so the last miles must be covered on foot or by bike.

siblingApproaches.approach: The standard approach is from the Downey Creek Trailhead (off Suiattle River Road) via the southern end of the Ptarmigan Traverse — a rugged, largely off-trail alpine route over Itswoot Ridge/Cub Lake and Bachelor Creek involving glacier travel and significant bushwhacking. Climbers typically budget a full day (or two) of approach before reaching the base of North Peak's granite West Face; this is an experienced-mountaineers-only objective, not a roadside crag.
